title: Malaysian Satay with Sticky Molasses Sauce
description: A classic Malaysian dish featuring marinated meat skewers served with a sweet and sticky molasses sauce. Perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, garlic, coriander, and salt.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with peanut oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine molasses, brown sugar, and lime juice in a small saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the satay hot with the sticky molasses sauce.
Garnish with toasted peanuts or sesame seeds, if desired.
